title: Proverb Submit — payload
description: A proverb, poem or guide given to the guide's keeper. The response ($defs.Response) is the appended link.

kind.description: proverb: one line. poem: a few lines. guide: a place and its first clue.

text.description: The words: at most 160 characters for a proverb or guide (its first clue), 1,500 for a poem.

title.description: REQUIRED for a guide (its name, at least 3 characters); a poem MAY carry one; ignored for a proverb.

by.description: OPTIONAL. The name the visitor signs with. Absent means unsigned.

place.description: OPTIONAL, guide only. The place the guide leads to.

offerToFm.description: OPTIONAL. True offers the words to be read on Hitchhiker FM (the Worker's `fm`). Absent or false means they are not.

sealed.description: OPTIONAL. The same words sealed to the visitor's own key, kept on the link so only its owner can open them later. Absent means nothing sealed is stored.

ct.description: The ciphertext, base64: at most 2,400 characters for a proverb or guide, 8,000 for a poem.

kind.description: Condition: the submission is a guide.

seq.description: The link's sequence number on the guide's chain.

hash.description: The link's hash, folding the previous link's hash.
